# Check estimated latency

> View estimated end-to-end latency for a Retell agent before going live — see which turtle-icon features are pushing latency higher than expected.

Retell platform achieves latency as low as 600ms, measured from when the user stops speaking to when the AI agent begins responding.

In the agent detail page, under the "Estimated Latency" section, you can view the average latency for the agent.

<Frame caption="Estimated Latency">
  <img height="700" src="https://mintcdn.com/retellai/a1LftRqc_k-5TDA7/reliability/images/latency.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=a1LftRqc_k-5TDA7&q=85&s=036a3fb04b4f9a14a64ed1a3e55127c6" alt="Agent header showing estimated latency with a breakdown for TTS, LLM, and transcription" data-path="reliability/images/latency.png" />
</Frame>

Please note that certain settings will increase latency. These settings are marked with a turtle icon.
